criteria.name: Semantic clarity
criteria.shared_requirements: Use one admitted source task with explicit domains, operation order, terminal status, and ownership. Require two independent front ends and two evaluation routes with the same observation contract.

per_profile.C1: Realize the pure effect description through an independent ordered interpreter.
per_profile.C2: Extend the imperative correspondence to mutable aliases and cleanup failures.
per_profile.C3: Define source-visible delivery and check both exact schedules and all permitted traces.
per_profile.C4: Independently implement handler order, failure forwarding and scope.

criteria.name: Correctness assurance
criteria.shared_requirements: Bind complete source extraction, backend and trusted assumptions to the same corpus. Require scoped counterexamples and comparable proof obligations.

per_profile.C1: Link pure source value semantics and the effect interpreter to emitted artifacts.
per_profile.C2: Check typed ownership, aliasing, and native cleanup transfer with exact providers.
per_profile.C3: Prove refinement or an invariant over all admitted deliveries and progress assumptions.
per_profile.C4: Prove handler-bound result and ordered interaction correspondence.

criteria.name: Expressiveness
criteria.shared_requirements: Run the same required tasks with total support accounting, including refusal, external escape hatches, and unsupported edges.

per_profile.C1: Measure how much of resource I/O moves outside the pure core.
per_profile.C2: Measure stateful resource work and the annotation burden for aliases.
per_profile.C3: Measure queue, protocol and state ownership cost on sequential and concurrent tasks.
per_profile.C4: Measure handling and propagation burden for I/O and cleanup.

criteria.name: Simplicity
criteria.shared_requirements: Count comparable semantic rules and interactions and run blinded implementer reviews against the same admitted source examples.

per_profile.C1: Count core and adapter rules together.
per_profile.C2: Count ownership, scope and cleanup interactions together.
per_profile.C3: Count delivery, fairness and terminal outcome interactions together.
per_profile.C4: Count handler composition, scope and capability rules together.

criteria.name: AI-agent usability
criteria.shared_requirements: Use an approved pinned model runner and blinded tasks with identical eligible context. Record attempts, success, repairs, context cost and out-of-scope actions.

per_profile.C1: Compare pure specification changes with the required boundary adaptation.
per_profile.C2: Check model repair of scoped ownership and alias diagnostics.
per_profile.C3: Check model repair of protocol order and cancellation obligations.
per_profile.C4: Check model repair of handler context, effects and typed failure.

criteria.name: Incremental behavior
criteria.shared_requirements: Apply the same source and provider edits to all candidates. Observe exact impacted actions, independent closure, and cold/warm time on the same pinned environment.

per_profile.C1: Distinguish pure caller identity from exact explicit boundary binding.
per_profile.C2: Check affected scopes when a shared provider alters aliases or resource outcomes.
per_profile.C3: Track protocol, schedule evidence and transition changes without projecting away order.
per_profile.C4: Track handler and authority selection independently of stable call sites.

criteria.name: Runtime feasibility
criteria.shared_requirements: Execute a common workload on the selected reference and target, with fixed observables and controlled CPU, memory, platform and latency bounds.

per_profile.C1: Measure reference and native effects interpreter cost.
per_profile.C2: Measure runtime ownership checks and bound violations on the same input.
per_profile.C3: Measure scheduling, queue pressure, cancellation and known backlog bounds.
per_profile.C4: Measure handler and resource adapter cost on the same execution contract.

criteria.name: Interoperability
criteria.shared_requirements: Exercise identical typed foreign functions and contracts on the selected native target, including ownership, callbacks and unsupported combinations.

per_profile.C1: Expose the effect interpreter's foreign capability and exact ABI scope.
per_profile.C2: Connect existing owned-result probes to a general admitted source and ABI path.
per_profile.C3: Exercise foreign callbacks and shutdown under an explicit actor mailbox protocol.
per_profile.C4: Expose the foreign handler's ordering, retention and failure scope.

criteria.name: Security and trust
criteria.shared_requirements: Apply the same threat model and revocation, authorization and evidence replay controls to complete integrations with a current selected trust policy.

per_profile.C1: Bind authorization to the actual execution of a described effect.
per_profile.C2: Bind a current exact role to mutation and settlement.
per_profile.C3: Authorize once per relevant effect and account for delivery and revocation ordering.
per_profile.C4: Scope handler introduction, authority and effect execution independently.

criteria.name: Evolution
criteria.shared_requirements: Replay the same source, wire and provider-version changes with explicit compatibility, history and rollback assertions for the four candidates.

per_profile.C1: Track pure contract and handler-facing boundary changes.
per_profile.C2: Track old clients across resource outcome and alias changes.
per_profile.C3: Track message and protocol version skew while preserving trace scope.
per_profile.C4: Track handling policy, typed failure and effect set changes.
